newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks lower, Zagrebacka heavily traded.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks lower, Zagrebacka heavily traded.

text.p: Croatian stocks ended mostly lower in Wednesday's buoyant trade, featuring Zagrebacka Banka.
* Eight of 17 active issues fell, five rose and four closed flat.
* Volume rose to 13,554 from 11,597 units but turnover more than doubled to 14.7 million kuna.
* Zagrebacka was most actively traded with 5,230 ordinary share sold.
* Hotelier Suncani Hvar, rising six kuna to 55 on volume of 1,292 shares, led gainers.
* Top decliners were A and B series of insurer Croatia Osiguranje, dipping 40 kuna to 1,210 on total volume of 15.
